It serves regulated and emerging markets - primarily the United States, Europe, Brazil, Latin America, Asia Pacific and Africa - through its own generic portfolio plus a contract manufacturing (CMO) business, and manufactured around 9.4 billion tablets/capsules during the year. litigation.note: The Board's Report, under 'Significant and Material Orders passed by the Regulators/Courts/Tribunals', discloses that during the year the Company paid a sum against an EU Commission demand notice relating to the Perindopril patent dispute of 2005. Apart from that, it states no significant or material orders were passed by any regulatory authority, court or tribunal that would affect the Company's going-concern status or future operations. The Board's Report also refers to impairment of investments in the associate company and the wholly owned subsidiaries (Notes 6, 37 and 40 of the standalone financial statements) - that is an accounting matter, not litigation.

risks.note: The BRSR material-issues table names regulatory compliance as the Company's own material risk: failure to comply fully with government regulations can delay or deny approvals for new products, raise development cost and impair the realisation of product revenues, while any non-compliance can trigger warning letters, import alerts, plant shutdowns and financial penalties, leading to loss of revenue and profitability. Mitigation rests on SOPs, international accreditations, independent audits and continuous cGMP training. Two formulation facilities were inspected by USFDA during the year and closed at Voluntary Action Indicated; one facility received EU-GMP certification.
risks.risk: Regulatory compliance risk across global drug regulators

risks.note: Unichem USA remains the largest contributor at 65% of total revenue, and management states the year saw modest revenue growth owing to sustained price erosion and loss of volumes in select high-margin molecules in the US generics portfolio, with gross margin impacted by US pricing pressure. The Company is responding by pivoting R&D toward complex generics with higher entry barriers.
risks.risk: US market concentration and sustained price erosion in generics

risks.note: Exports contribute 98.5% of consolidated (97.6% standalone) total sales revenue, so the business is structurally exposed to trade policy. Management notes demand turned highly volatile in the last quarter of FY 2026 due to geopolitical uncertainty, tariff threats, trade barriers and war situations, and that geopolitical uncertainty is accelerating regionalisation of manufacturing, with major players exploring US-based manufacturing to mitigate tariff risk.
risks.risk: Export dependence and geopolitical / tariff exposure

risks.note: Increased cost of goods sold arose from supply chain disruptions during the year, and management flags that the ongoing West Asia conflict may keep supply chain costs at elevated levels in the near term, which may impact margins. Mitigation includes multi-site validation of critical products and accelerated alternate-site qualification for APIs, which provide operational flexibility to respond to market disruptions.
risks.risk: Supply chain disruption and input cost inflation

risks.note: The MD&A Risk & Concern section names product recalls and liability, counterfeiting and patient safety as industry risks where reputational stake is very high, requiring careful risk assessment through the entire drug development and manufacturing process. The BRSR material-issues table adds that any health and safety incident has the potential to erode customer trust and adversely affect product demand; mitigation centres on CAPA tracking with a particular emphasis on Data Integrity and a Total Lifecycle Management approach.
risks.risk: Product quality, data integrity, recalls and product liability

risks.note: Securing investment for R&D funding is described as a formidable challenge given the extensive financial commitments required over an extended period and the high risk of failure. The BRSR notes the launch of new products involves substantial investment and is subject to regulatory hurdles, intense competition and patent litigation which may impact timelines. Cost during the year rose mainly on R&D for product development, ANDA fees and bioequivalence studies.
risks.risk: R&D funding burden and new-product launch execution risk

risks.note: Management notes that ERP, CRM, RPA and AI platforms have moved from support functions to the backbone of operations, transactions and reporting, and that while these enhance efficiency and scalability they introduce cybersecurity risk. Mitigation during the year included adequate insurance coverage against various risks including cybersecurity, with identified risks and measures presented to the Risk Committee.

The Board's Report discloses that during the year the Company paid a sum against an EU Commission demand notice relating to the Perindopril patent dispute of 2005 - a demonstrated tail-risk from historical patent litigation. It also cross-refers to impairment of investments in the associate company and the wholly owned subsidiaries (Notes 6, 37 and 40 of the standalone financial statements), indicating value written down in group entities.
risks.risk: Legacy litigation and impairment of investments in group entities
